05Questions

Asked,
answered.

Everything founders usually ask before we start. Anything else — ask us on WhatsApp.

Which email platform do you use?+

We work with Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or Brevo — depending on your business size and needs.

How do you grow my email list?+

Through lead magnets, website popups, social captures, and WhatsApp opt-ins.

Will my emails land in spam?+

We handle full technical setup — SPF, DKIM, DMARC — and warm up your domain properly.

How often should I send emails?+

2-4 emails/week for e-commerce. 1-2/week for services. We optimize frequency based on data.

Can you recover abandoned carts?+

Yes. Our cart recovery flows typically recover 15-28% of abandoned carts.
